messages.subject: Lunchtime CPD - Building Safety Act update (8 April)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

A reminder that the real estate team's lunchtime CPD session on the Building Safety Act and remediation contribution orders is on Wednesday 8 April, 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate boardroom. Sandwiches provided. Please let me know if attending.

Donna
